g.text: 4. The base case: affordability improves, retained protection falls
Authored scenario arithmetic, in USD. These are conditional inputs and outcomes, not measured business results.

g.text: Conditional recovery: 0 / 4 orders when cash stays at $100; 4 / 4 if the $160 purchase is feasible and the replacement delivers on time.
Adverse case: if the replacement fails before capture, recovery is 0 / 4. Releasing cash does not create stock or guarantee fulfillment.

g.text: The policy floor is authored for this demo. Unknown obligations require abstention. The retained reserve is not a calibrated measure of PayPal loss.
Research basis: completed Aftershock report, 19 October 2026. Not an official PayPal design.
